description: Restructure a building inspection report into a professional multi-section document. Open /home/ga/Documents/inspection_report.docx, which is currently a single continuous section in portrait orientation. You must restructure it into 5 distinct sections with specific layouts: (1) Title Page [Portrait, No Header]; (2) Executive Summary & Body [Portrait, Header: 'ABC Engineering Associates — CONFIDENTIAL']; (3) Appendix A [Landscape, Header: 'Appendix A — Floor Plans & Deficiency Matrix']; (4) Appendix B [Landscape, Header: 'Appendix B — Cost Estimates']; (5) Appendix C [Portrait, Header: 'Appendix C — Certifications & Qualifications']. Insert 'Next Page' section breaks at the start of 'EXECUTIVE SUMMARY', 'APPENDIX A', 'APPENDIX B', and 'APPENDIX C'. Unlink headers to ensure they are specific to each section. Save the result as /home/ga/Documents/inspection_report_formatted.docx.
